correctness.rationale: The block-embedding proof is mathematically correct. For R from ell_1(Delta) to ell_1(Gamma), place R in the lower-left block of an endomorphism A on ell_1(Delta disjoint-union Gamma). The published universal second-adjoint norm-attainment theorem for ell_1(Lambda) endomorphisms gives a unit vector at which A** attains its norm; the ell_1 direct-sum norm then forces the Delta coordinate to have norm one, so R** attains its norm. Conjugating T* by the given surjective linear isometries Y* to ell_1(Delta) and X* to ell_1(Gamma), then bidualizing, transfers norm attainment to T***. The zero and finite-index cases are immediate, and the c example does show that depth two cannot be a uniform replacement for depth three.
